record.dic_text:
06159 `Oreb {o-rabe'} 或 `Owreb {o-rabe'};

與 06158 同;

欽定本 - Oreb 7; 7

俄立 = 「掠奪」
陽性專有名詞
1) 米甸人的首領, 基甸打敗其軍隊 (#士 7|)
專有名詞 地名
2) 約旦河東的一塊磐石, 俄立和其部份軍隊在此敗給以法連人 (# 士 7:25|)
record.edic_text:
06159 `Oreb {o-rabe'} or `Owreb {o-rabe'};

the same as 06158;

AV - Oreb 7; 7

Oreb = "raven"
n pr m
1) one of the chieftains of the Midianite army defeated by Gideon
n pr loc
2) a rock east of the Jordan where Oreb and part of his army fell
   to the Ephraimites
